title: Structural Characterization and Engineering of a GH134 beta-Mannanase from Aspergillus nidulans for Enhancement of Activity and Stability.
authors: Chen, Sheng-Chia; Kuo, Po-Chih; Chen, Wen-Ming; Sheu, Shih-Yi; Huang, Yu-Bin; Huang, Cheng-Yang; Chien, I-Weh; Lee, Tzong-Huei; Hsu, Chun-Hua
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构解析、对接、突变和分子动力学模拟表征并工程化改造一种β-甘露聚糖酶，虽涉及蛋白质结构计算（对接、MD），但核心是酶学性质优化，而非蛋白质结构预测、构象采样或通用结构计算方法创新，与本课题的蛋白质结构计算建模方向关联较弱。
abstract: Mannans are abundant plant hemicelluloses, and endo-beta-mannanases are important biocatalysts for their conversion into functional manno-oligosaccharides. Here, we report the structural and functional characterization of a glycoside hydrolase family 134 beta-mannanase from Aspergillus nidulans (AnGH134) and a structure-guided engineering strategy to improve its performance on locust bean gum. The 1.75 A crystal structure reveals the conserved lysozyme-like fold of GH134 enzymes and supports an inverting catalytic mechanism with Glu43 and Asp55 as the putative catalytic residues. Docking, mutational, and molecular dynamics analyses indicate that AnGH134 uses an extended substrate-binding groove and that groove-exit residues and the C-terminal region contribute to productive catalysis. Guided by these findings, N-terminal fusion of CBM10 enhanced catalytic efficiency and thermal stability, whereas C-terminal fusion was detrimental. These results provide a framework for engineering GH134 mannanases.
abstract_zh: 甘露聚糖是丰富的植物半纤维素，内切-β-甘露聚糖酶是将其转化为功能性甘露寡糖的重要生物催化剂。本文报道了来自构巢曲霉（Aspergillus nidulans）的糖苷水解酶家族134 β-甘露聚糖酶（AnGH134）的结构与功能表征，以及一种基于结构导向的工程化策略，以提升其在刺槐豆胶上的性能。1.75 Å的晶体结构揭示了GH134酶保守的溶菌酶样折叠，并支持以Glu43和Asp55为假定催化残基的反转催化机制。对接、突变及分子动力学（molecular dynamics）分析表明，AnGH134利用一个延伸的底物结合沟槽，且沟槽出口残基及C端区域有助于高效催化。基于这些发现，N端融合CBM10增强了催化效率和热稳定性，而C端融合则产生不利影响。这些结果为工程化GH134甘露聚糖酶提供了框架。
